data.name: Atmaan
data.long_meaning: The name Atmaan is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Atman’, which means self or soul. In Hinduism, the self or soul is believed to be a part of the divine Brahman. The name Atmaan signifies the inherent spiritual nature of an individual and encourages the exploration of one’s inner self.

The name serves as a constant reminder of one's connection to the divine and the importance of striving for self-improvement and self-discovery.

It emphasizes the importance of introspection, self-awareness, and seeking the truth within oneself. The name encourages one to look inward, to discover and nurture their inner self and to live in harmony with their true nature. It is a powerful reminder of the eternal soul that resides within every being and is a call to embrace the spiritual journey of self-discovery and enlightenment.
